text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart didn't seem to be feeling well,
so I brought her to the infirmary.
choice_data_list: Let's get a good night's sleep and get into top shape.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Will do, Trainer.
I'll recover thoroughly and get back to perfect♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Where... am I?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wahhhh~~!! Somebody~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A dorsal fin rising from the sea!
It's a giant monsteer~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sea Monster
text_block_list.text: ROOOOAR!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Not on my watch!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Still, what should we do...?! If this were a movie, a weapon to counter it would conveniently—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Look, it's right there!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Eat this!
Take this! And THIS!

text_block_list.name: Sea Monster
text_block_list.text: GROOOAAAR!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san, thank you~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No thanks are necessary.
...More importantly, there's no resistance.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: At times like this, without fail—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Oh no!! That monster from before is coming back with a whole horde this time!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's a promise.
I can't just sit around. I've got to get ready!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Preparations?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Conveniently, there's probably
weapons lying around for all of us—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we could use this?
There were a bunch of them sitting in the storage shed.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nice! In that case,
let me tell everyone the most important thing.

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: The most important thing...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's all about the "vibe"!
In the end, good vibes carry the day!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone!
We've got a monster to beat!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm...
Was that a dream?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Still... fufu. It was quite an exciting dream, just like a movie.
